definitions.explanation: Yoga practiced in a room heated to around 35–40°C and kept at high humidity, intended to promote flexibility and sweating. Widely offered as a class-based studio service in Japan.

examples.japanese: ホットヨガ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
ホットヨガ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かいた。
examples.english: I sweated heavily doing hot yoga.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|ひ}え{性|しょう}→冷え性：18211_hieshou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ホットヨガ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend hot yoga to deal with my poor circulation.

notes:
Loanword. Commonly marketed in Japan for ⟦{冷|ひ}え{性|しょう}→冷え性：18211_hieshou⟧ (sensitivity to cold) and ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧ (beauty/skin care) benefits as much as for fitness.
